name: Shaded Sheriffs
tagline: Camera glasses that describe what you see in a cowboy voice, with a belt sensor and caregiver dashboard.
problem: Visual cues in the physical world are unavailable to blind and low-vision people.
solution: Smart glasses capture the view and Gemini describes it aloud; an ultrasonic belt warns of obstacles; a western-themed dashboard lets caregivers check in.
demo_moment: Team-described: look at a sign and hear it described.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Low Level Hack (Opt-In)” among 231 submissions.

lessons: A theme can make a serious device memorable.
